implementation: Replaced the inline Flutter ExpansionTile/240 px list with the web-style compact bordered summary and anchored raised popover. The popover is 288 px wide (viewport minus 32 px on smaller screens), scrollable and viewport-height constrained; it flips above the trigger when bottom space is limited. It closes on outside tap or Escape, while the trigger exposes button/expanded/status semantics.
